# StayTick DMC

> StayTick DMC is a tour operator and DMC (destination management company) based in Madrid, Spain. We plan and run trips for travel agencies, tour operators, OTAs and companies. Legal entity: STAYTICK TRAVEL SL.

## What we do
- Groups and coach tours (students, universities, seniors)
- Tours in several countries (for example Spain, Portugal, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, France and the Adriatic), with one itinerary, one quote and one team
- MICE, incentives, offsites and corporate or government delegations
- Honeymoons and luxury stays
- VIP airport meet-and-assist across Europe and Mercedes cars with a professional driver
- Ski, rail and theme-park packages
- Car at disposal and car rental
- Villas and special stays across Europe

## Who we work with
Travel agencies; tour operators and OTAs; corporate travel departments; SaaS and technology companies (offsites, incentives, client events); event and incentive agencies; schools and universities; DMC partners abroad.

## Destinations
Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Andalusia, the islands), Italy (from the lakes and Venice to Tuscany, Rome, the Amalfi Coast and Sicily), multi-country Europe, the United States and Japan (Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka, with trusted local partners).

## Markets
We work with companies and travel brands in the United States, Brazil, Mexico, the United Kingdom and the Gulf.

## StayTick DMC and Trekko
A DMC like StayTick DMC designs a full trip on request. Trekko (https://trekko.co), our sister brand, is a bed bank where travel agencies book hotels (3M+ properties), transfers and car rental online themselves at net prices. Use Trekko for simple bookings and StayTick DMC for anything that needs planning.
